questions.question: Do you currently have, or have you previously been diagnosed with, any of the following skin conditions? Select any that apply.

effects.safety: Context only. Do not score a diagnosed skin condition as cardiovascular disease or as a general health deficit.
effects.report: If selected, can provide condition-specific context and, where appropriate, an impact follow-up.

questions.logic: None of these is mutually exclusive with all other choices. Selecting a condition reveals Q16b.

questions.question: How much does this skin condition currently affect your day-to-day life?

effects.safety: Context severity only; no direct wellness-score deduction.
effects.report: Distinguishes a historical/minor diagnosis from a currently significant condition.

questions.logic: Only shown when Q16 is not 'None of these'.

questions.question: How often do you find yourself craving sweet or highly processed foods?

effects.safety: Non-diagnostic. A craving is not treated as evidence of excessive intake.
effects.report: Can be used as a supporting dietary-behaviour signal, particularly alongside actual dietary intake questions.

questions.question: Which of the following best describes your relationship with dairy products?
options: I avoid dairy because it causes symptoms
I have a diagnosed dairy allergy

effects.safety: Recommendation filter. Dairy consumption itself is not a health deficit; diagnosed allergy is a safety constraint.
effects.report: Normally used to personalise recommendations rather than create an outcome score.

questions.question: How often do you feel unusually low, flat or lacking motivation?

effects.report: Higher frequency contributes to the Mood, Stress & Emotional Balance signal and may provide context for low energy.

questions.question: How would you describe the quality of your sleep?

effects.report: Higher frequency/poorer quality contributes directly to Sleep & Recovery. Can be interpreted with Q21, Q30, Q35, Q37 and N06.

design_note: Q16 has become a specific diagnosed skin-condition context question with a conditional impact follow-up. Q17 is a supporting dietary-behaviour signal. Q18 is profile/safety information, not a score. Q19 is a direct Mood/Stress signal. Q20 is the first primary Sleep & Recovery question and should carry more weight than supporting sleep modifiers.
